$comment: Hand-authored. Contrast Boost's colors and shadows come from tokens.json; its geometry is prose in the design system, so it is kept here as rules. The site has no Contrast Boost control: the generator applies them inside @media (prefers-contrast: more). The Contrast Boost colors are a dark palette, so they apply to the dark theme only (light colors under prefers-contrast are boosted by site-roles.json). The geometry below and the shadow drop do not depend on the theme, so they apply to both themes: a light-theme reader who asks for more contrast also gets doubled borders, the 3px focus ring and bigger controls. Log any change back to the design system.
source: design system README: Contrast Boost doubles every border (hairline 0.5 to 1, default 1 to 2, emphasis 3 to 6, indicator 4 to 8), draws every control 8pt bigger (40 to 48, 48 to 56, 56 to 64), drops every shadow; the focus ring is 3px.
